name: kirocrew
gates: BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && SCOPED_TESTS_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/run_scoped_tests.py --surface backend
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && BRAND_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/check_brand_name.py
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && HARNESS_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/check_harness_parity.py
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && FEATURE_MAP_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/check_feature_map.py
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && CHANGELOG_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/check_changelog_history.py
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && FOCUS_CUE_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/check_focus_cue.py
MW="$(grep -oE 'npx eslint src/ --max-warnings [0-9]+' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -oE '[0-9]+$')" && [ -n "$MW" ] && (cd website && npx eslint src/ --max-warnings "$MW")
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && I18N_BASE_REF="$BASE" npm --prefix website run i18n:check
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && PHANTOM_BASE_REF="$BASE" npm --prefix website run lint:phantom-classes
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && I18N_BASE_REF="$BASE" npm --prefix website run i18n:render
BASE="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && I18N_BASE_REF="$BASE" SCOPED_TESTS_BASE_REF="$BASE" python3 scripts/run_scoped_tests.py --surface frontend
(cd website && node --max-old-space-size=6144 ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode analyze && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs)
